uname
=====

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``linux:live_response:system:uname``**

   * name_rex: ``--uname-.*\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``system``
   * sourcetype: ``linux:live_response:system:uname``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * artifact: ``uname``

Description
-----------

Kernel and platform identification from uname -a
